transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling a lot with my eating lately. I keep finding myself eating huge amounts of food in a very short time, and it feels like I completely lose control and can't stop. It's really starting to worry me, so I wanted to get some help.
After these episodes of eating large amounts of food, do you ever try to get rid of the calories by vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't vomit or use laxatives, but I definitely try to compensate in other ways. I'll push myself to exercise excessively for hours to burn off the calories, or I'll just fast and completely stop eating for a while to prevent gaining weight.
How often do these episodes of binge eating followed by excessive exercise or fasting occur, and have you been experiencing them for more than three months?

Both the binge eating and the fasting or heavy exercising happen at least once a week on average. It's been going on for much longer than three months, though—I've actually been struggling with this for about two years and three months now.

Do you have a strong fear of gaining weight or becoming fat, and does your self-esteem or body image play a significant role in your decision to engage in these binge eating and compensatory behaviors?

Yes, I have a massive fear of gaining weight, and my self-esteem is completely tied to my body shape. When I look in the mirror, I see myself as much larger than I actually am, which makes me feel worthless. It's those feelings of body dissatisfaction that drive me to fast and exercise so excessively.
Can you tell me your current weight and height, as this information will help me better understand your overall health and body mass index?
I'm actually not sure of my exact weight or height right now. I haven't measured myself recently, so I don't know those numbers off the top of my head.
Have you experienced any significant weight fluctuations in the past, such as rapid weight loss or gain, and if so, how have you attempted to manage those changes?

Yes, my weight does fluctuate quite a bit, and I constantly worry about any weight gain. To manage these changes, I resort to extreme methods like fasting, where I completely stop eating for certain periods, and doing excessive exercise that pushes way past my physical limits.
Have you experienced any changes in your menstrual cycle, such as irregular periods or amenorrhea, which could be related to your eating habits and weight fluctuations?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my menstrual cycle. It's not something I've been tracking closely, so I'm not really sure if there has been any difference.
Are you currently underweight, as defined by a body mass index (BMI) below 17, which is a key diagnostic criterion for Anorexia Nervosa?
I'm not really sure if I'm technically underweight or what my exact BMI is right now. I haven't calculated it or checked my weight recently, so I don't know where I stand.

Can you describe in more detail how your body image and fear of gaining weight influence your eating habits and compensatory behaviors, and are there any specific thoughts or feelings that trigger these behaviors?

My self-worth is entirely tied to my weight and shape, and when I look in the mirror, I always see myself as much fatter than I actually am. These negative thoughts and my intense fear of gaining weight are what trigger me to fast or exercise excessively. It feels like the only way I can try to regain control over my body.
Would you be willing to step on the scale and have your height measured so we can determine your current BMI and better understand your overall health status?

Oh, please, I really don't think I can step on the scale right now. Just the thought of seeing that number makes me incredibly anxious because my self-worth is so tied to it. I'm absolutely terrified of what it will say.
